distance.description: Weighted sum of squared standardized errors over the moment vector. For moment i with simulated value s_i, target t_i and scale c_i: e_i = (s_i - t_i) / c_i. Objective J = sum_i w_i * e_i^2. Scales and weights are fixed below.

frozen_note: This file was written before any optimization run. Changing moments, bounds, weights, or optimizer settings after seeing results invalidates the calibration. Any change requires a new dated prereg file.
moments_note: 16 moments. Drawdown is a reported diagnostic only, not an optimized moment: the target max_drawdown_252d is computed over 252-day windows while the simulator runs 126-day windows, so the quantities are not directly comparable. Overnight-gap statistics are excluded: the hourly simulator has no overnight session. All moments are computed on simulated daily closes (mid at every 24th hourly step after warmup) with the same definitions as compute_targets.py in the calibration research directory.

restarts.note: Dicks and Gebbie recipe: local search plus stochastic global moves.

parameters.maps_to: MomentumTrader(lookback), rounded to int inside the objective
parameters.name: momentum_lookback

parameters.maps_to: runner: fraction of agents that are NoiseTrader; remainder split value:momentum:mm = 102:12:2 (RMSC-04 ratios), minimum 1 market maker
parameters.name: noise_frac

parameters_fixed.FundamentalTrader(fair_value): anchored to initial price each run
parameters_fixed.agents_note: Total agents fixed at 32 for compute budget; only the noise fraction is calibrated. RMSC-04 ratios (1000 noise : 102 value : 12 momentum : 2 market makers) set the starting population prior.

parameters_note: 9 free parameters, mirroring the PGPS 6-parameter precedent scaled to 4 archetypes. Bounds are enforced by a logit transform to the unit hypercube; the optimizer runs unconstrained in transformed space.

simulation.note: 126 trading days balances moment quality (autocorr lag 20 needs 40+ consecutive days; Hill 5% tail needs 300+ pooled returns) against budget. At ~0.6s per replication, 3 replications is ~2s per objective evaluation; 400 evaluations is ~15 minutes.
simulation.seed_note: Fixed seeds per evaluation for a deterministic objective (common random numbers reduce optimizer chatter). Final validation reruns with fresh seeds.

targets.holdout_note: HOLDOUT (2024-01-01..latest) must not be read during fitting. The fitter accepts only the fit targets file; holdout statistics are computed once, after optimization, for the final validation table.

validation_plan: After optimization, recompute all 16 moments on the HOLDOUT period from raw bars (never used in fitting) and report fit-period vs holdout-period moment errors side by side.

Degeneracy analysis: rerun optimization from 3 distinct starting points (bounds center, low corner, high corner). If final objectives agree within 10 percent but parameter vectors differ substantially, report parameter degeneracy and do not present a spuriously precise point estimate.
Report the drawdown diagnostic (simulated 126-day max drawdown vs target 252-day distribution) as context, not as a fitted moment.
